characters.name: Elarion Voss
characters.description: Unwanted spare son of minor House Voss. Painfully average in looks and talent. Transmigrator with secret time-loop memories. Inherently kind; eventual embodiment of the End.

characters.name: Lirien Thorne
characters.description: Charismatic schemer from a house of diplomats and spies. Illusion mage. Ambitious, sharp, not cartoonishly evil.

characters.name: Seraphiel Kane
characters.description: Gentle healer-mage. Moral center of the omega cohort. Empathy as strength and liability.

characters.name: Vesper Quill
characters.description: Quiet observer and information broker. Shadow-adjacent Skill user with subtle foresight hints.

characters.name: Aurelius Dawn
characters.description: Fierce warrior-track omega. Scarred, proud, battle-hungry. Challenges omega stereotypes.

characters.name: Draven Valerius
characters.description: Crown Prince. Charismatic, possessive, politically sharp. Often Elarion's first-loop romantic focus.

characters.name: Kael Valerius
characters.description: Second prince. Scholar-strategist. Chess-mind; runes, court law, long games.

characters.name: Thorne Valerius
characters.description: Third prince. Brooding shadow. Assassin's grace and secrets within secrets.

characters.name: Riven Valerius
characters.description: Fourth prince. Wild storm. Battle-lust, raw power, impulsive loyalty.

characters.name: Soren Valerius
characters.description: Fifth prince. Quiet visionary. Prophecy-adjacent interests. Unsettling calm.

characters.name: Emperor Valerius
characters.description: Sovereign of the Valerian Empire. Arranges alliances, engineers succession games, treats lives as chess pieces.
